name: Asymptotic Analysis & Big-O Notation
description: Understanding time and space complexity, Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta notation, and common complexity classes.

name: Arrays & Strings
description: Memory layout of arrays, dynamic arrays, two-pointer techniques, sliding window patterns, and string manipulation.

name: Linked Lists
description: Singly and doubly linked lists, cycle detection (Floyd's algorithm), reversals, and list-based implementations.

name: Stacks & Queues
description: LIFO and FIFO operations, monotonic stacks, deque, and applications such as parenthesis matching and expression evaluation.

name: Recursion & Backtracking
description: Base cases, call stack mechanics, recursion tree analysis, and exhaustive search problems (N-Queens, subsets, permutations).

name: Binary Trees & Binary Search Trees
description: Tree traversals (inorder, preorder, postorder, level-order), BST invariants, balanced trees concept, and lowest common ancestor.

name: Heaps & Priority Queues
description: Binary heaps, heapify operation, priority queue operations, and applications such as Top-K elements and median maintenance.

name: Graphs & Traversals
description: Adjacency matrix vs list, Breadth-First Search (BFS), Depth-First Search (DFS), topological sorting, and cycle detection in DAGs.

name: Shortest Paths & Minimum Spanning Trees
description: Dijkstra's algorithm, Bellman-Ford algorithm, Prim's and Kruskal's MST algorithms, Disjoint Set Union (DSU).

name: Dynamic Programming
description: Optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, memoization vs tabulation, knapsack patterns, and state-transition modeling.
